verification.scope: Beginner suitability and structural validation for 600 sentences; sentence pinyin and English added in v1.6.0. Examples/translations are not individually corpus-attested or native-speaker certified.
verification.word_id_source: Entry IDs 1–300 are carried over unchanged from the supplied v1.3.0 dataset. This export does NOT independently certify that these numbers match the November 2025 official syllabus serial numbers.
verification.conversational_examples: 300 original conversational examples retained except targeted corrections for naturalness and beginner vocabulary.
verification.written_examples: Most second examples replaced with short everyday descriptions, classroom instructions, or written dialogue, instead of advanced/literary formal language.
verification.register_policy: written=plain written descriptions or classroom notices, not high-register Chinese. Spoken particles and greetings appear in written dialogue when formal prose would be unnatural.
verification.difficulty_policy: Prefer HSK 3.0 2025 Level 1; allow common Level 2 vocabulary and grammar. Transparent compounds and proper names may be present. No Level 3 把 disposal construction or chair classifier, 需要, 应该, 如果.
verification.translation_and_pinyin: 300 headword meanings come directly from the original XLSX-derived v1.1.0 dataset. For sentences unchanged from original XLSX, pinyin and English are reused from the original. For rewritten/new sentences, pinyin and translations are editorial enrichments (using ICU Han-Latin lexicon with curated lexical readings and sandhi), not independently native-speaker certified; manual review is recommended.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_policy: Hard ceiling: November 2025 HSK 3.0 Level 2 cumulative vocabulary (IDs 1–500). Level 1 examples may use Level 2 items; Level 3+ standalone vocabulary is not intentionally introduced. Normal grammar particles and contracted negative 没 (short form of 没有) are allowed; orthographic parts inside a listed word are not treated as separate unlisted vocabulary. Original lexical lists do not encode every compositional collocation. Independent linguistic/native-speaker verification has not been performed.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_audit: A vocabulary-token segmentation screen was applied to 100% of example sentences; all characters in Hanzi sentences are covered by Level 1/2 headwords, except standalone 没 (a grammatically licensed short form of 没有). This is a segmentation heuristic, not a conclusive proof of lexical or grammar-level compliance. This statement describes the earlier vocabulary screen and does not cover the v1.7.1 revisions.
verification.sentence_revision: v1.7.1: Applied the supplied register and naturalness patch to 33 sentences across 32 Level 1 entries. Updated pinyin, translations, notes and register for those examples. ID 127 uses the non-erhua written counterpart of the headword. Vocabulary compliance of the revised sentences was not independently verified.

verification.word_id_source: November 2025 official HSK 3.0 syllabus; entries 301–500, preserving source serial ID and order. Transcribed from the referenced 2025 syllabus table.
verification.sentence_policy: Two examples per headword. Sentence 1 (style=conversational) models natural interactive or everyday spoken usage, including neutral spoken statements. Sentence 2 (style=written; register=plain_written) models clear beginner-level descriptive, narrative, explanatory, instructional, or quoted written text. Neither style is exclusive to its medium; written does not mean formal/literary, and natural speech/writing overlap. Prefer HSK 3.0 Levels 1–2 vocabulary and grammar; do not force advanced vocabulary to create artificial register differences.
verification.translation_policy: Chinese sentences, pinyin, English meanings, and translations are newly prepared editorial material. They are not individually corpus-attested or independently native-speaker certified.
verification.pinyin_policy: Tone-marked official syllable pinyin for headwords; sentence pinyin is editorial, assembled from 2025 Levels 1–2 lexicon and Unicode Han-Latin transliteration for out-of-list characters, with curated neutral-tone/tone-sandhi handling. Manual proofreading recommended.
verification.taxonomy_policy: Use the 22 shared top-level topics and 25 subtopics from taxonomy v2.0.0.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_policy: Hard ceiling: November 2025 HSK 3.0 Level 2 cumulative vocabulary (IDs 1–500). Level 1 examples may use Level 2 items; Level 3+ standalone vocabulary is not intentionally introduced. Normal grammar particles and contracted negative 没 (short form of 没有) are allowed; orthographic parts inside a listed word are not treated as separate unlisted vocabulary. Original lexical lists do not encode every compositional collocation. Independent linguistic/native-speaker verification has not been performed.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_audit: Prior releases underwent heuristic vocabulary segmentation and character coverage screening. In v1.1.1, revised examples were editorially reviewed for beginner vocabulary. No independent full word-level audit was performed for this release.
verification.sentence_revision: v1.1.1: Revised selected conversational and plain-written examples and standardized selected plural-suffix spacing in pinyin. Prior vocabulary screening was heuristic. Strict cumulative HSK 1–2 compliance has not been independently verified at the word level for this release.

verification.translation_policy: English headword glosses and sentence translations were newly authored; independently reviewed native-speaker or corpus verification is not claimed.
verification.pinyin_policy: Headword pinyin follows the 2025 syllabus transcription. Sentence pinyin generated using HSK Levels 1–3 vocabulary, ICU Han-Latin fallback, and contextual lexical overrides. Manual pronunciation review remains necessary.

verification.vocabulary_boundary_policy: Levels 1–3 cumulative exam vocabulary (official IDs 1–1000). The mechanical audit does not guarantee grammatical or semantic correctness.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_audit: Full 1,000-sentence character-coverage screen using the cumulative HSK 1–3 headword lexicon; 101 candidate higher-level word occurrences or non-listed functional items were revised. Manual sense-level/editorial review is distinct from licensed-source or native-speaker verification.

verification.quality_control_1_0_1: Targeted review of demonstrative senses, polyphonic readings, classroom-natural phrasing, redundant clauses and misclassified concrete nouns. Does not constitute an exhaustive native-speaker audit of all 2,000 sentences.
